gdpr.title: Before we begin
gdpr.message: This interview will be recorded and analysed by AI. Your responses will be used solely to evaluate your candidacy for this assessment.
gdpr.body: This interview is conducted by an AI agent that analyzes your responses in real time — including verbal and non-verbal communication — to assess your fit for this position.
gdpr.bullet_data: Your session data (video, audio, and transcript) is securely stored for the duration of the active recruitment campaign only. It is accessible exclusively to the hiring team and will be permanently deleted once the job post is closed.
gdpr.bullet_privacy: TalentAI does not share, sell, or transfer your personal data to any third party. All data is processed in compliance with GDPR and applicable data protection regulations.
gdpr.confirmation: By continuing, you confirm that you are the person listed in your application and that your responses are your own.

start.title: Ready to begin?
start.description: This is a live AI interview. Speak your answers clearly and at a natural pace.

intro.voice_video_desc: Answer questions via voice & video. The AI will adapt based on your responses.
intro.tip1: Find a quiet place with good lighting
intro.tip3: Speak clearly — take time to think
intro.tip4: You can ask the AI to repeat a question

container.ready_subtitle: Your AI interviewer is ready and waiting.
container.starting_subtitle: Please wait while we connect you to your AI interviewer.
container.analyzing_subtitle: Please wait while we prepare your report.

camera.speak_clearly: Speak clearly — your voice is being captured
camera.start_to_record: Start the interview to enable recording
camera.allow_access: Allow camera & microphone access to begin

pipeline.loading_subtitle: Please wait while we prepare your interview
pipeline.wrong_step_desc: You will be redirected to your current step automatically.
pipeline.blocked_desc: Unfortunately, you did not pass a previous step in this pipeline. The interview cannot be started.
pipeline.blocked_contact: Please contact the company if you believe this is an error.

security.warning_desc: was detected. This interview is monitored. Please stay focused and keep this window active.
security.prohibited_copy: Copy, cut, or paste any text
security.terminated_desc: Multiple security violations were detected. The interview has been automatically terminated and the hiring team has been notified.

end.confirm_message: This assessment can only be taken once. Are you sure you want to end it now?

ended.title: Interview Complete
ended.subtitle: Thank you for completing this assessment.
ended.redirect: You'll be redirected automatically once they're ready.

errors.connection: Connection lost. Please refresh the page.
errors.microphone: Could not access your microphone. Please check browser permissions.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please rejoin via the campaign link.
errors.start_failed: Failed to start assessment. Please try again.

lang_modal.desc_multi: This interview is available in multiple languages. Select the one you're most comfortable with.
lang_modal.desc_single: This interview will be conducted in the language shown below.
lang_modal.single_lang_note: This interview is configured in this language only.
